summary: NISCH-012 Continuous Motion Telemetry Bridge E2E Verification Complete. All 45 tests passed (21 E2E + 15 motion_features unit + 9 swallow_audit). POST /api/sensors/motion/features endpoint verified: auth (401 without token), validation (422 for invalid activity_class, 422 for >12 windows), idempotency (duplicate returns status=duplicate), happy-path (200 with inserted=1, telemetry_pipeline_version present). Trust badge motion_telemetry_stale reason verified (MEDIUM only, never LOW). Fall detection pipeline regression verified (5-stage pipeline still works). All behavioral endpoints still respond. Risk predict endpoint still works. Database schema verified: motion_features table with 15 columns and 4 indexes. Alembic at ep1a2b3c4ec01 (head). Swallow audit ratchet held: unresolved_debt=1.
critical_code_review_comments: NISCH-012 motion_features.py: POST /api/sensors/motion/features endpoint with per-window ON CONFLICT (idempotency_key) DO NOTHING for idempotency. Batch commit with swallow-audit entry at line 166.
NISCH-012 models/motion_features.py: ALLOWED_ACTIVITY_CLASSES locked at 5 values (stationary, walking, running, vehicle, anomalous). TELEMETRY_PIPELINE_VERSION='motion-2026.02.1'.
NISCH-012 baseline.py lines 174-200: Motion enrichment is ADDITIVE — failure does NOT block baseline rebuild. GPS-derived mobility_signature is preserved untouched on motion-aggregate failure.
NISCH-012 trust.py: MOTION_FRESHNESS_MEDIUM_RED_S=1800 (30 min). Motion staleness is observational — surfaces as MEDIUM only, NEVER LOW.
NISCH-012 badge.py: REASON_PRIORITY ladder includes motion_telemetry_stale between unresolved_backlog and insufficient_reconciliation_window.
NISCH-012 migration ep1a2b3c4ec01: motion_features table with 15 columns, UNIQUE idempotency_key constraint, 4 indexes (entity_window, idempotency, activity_class).
Swallow audit ratchet held: idempotency_race=1, compensating_action_exists=41, unresolved_debt=1.
seed_data_creation: 22 motion_features rows created during E2E testing (test data with unique device_ids and timestamps).
context_for_next_testing_agent: NISCH-012 Continuous Motion Telemetry Bridge fully verified. Alembic at ep1a2b3c4ec01 (head). E2E tests: 21/21 passed (auth, validation, idempotency, happy-path, trust badge, fall detection regression, behavioral regression, risk predict regression). Unit tests: 15/15 passed (taxonomy, trust evaluator, reason ladder, API endpoint). Swallow audit: 9/9 passed (ratchet held at unresolved_debt=1). Risk predict: endpoint still works. MOCKED: None - all motion telemetry features are real implementations.

POST_motion_features_auth.description: Endpoint requires auth. Returns 401 without token.

POST_motion_features_validation_activity.description: Rejects out-of-taxonomy activity_class with 422. Only stationary/walking/running/vehicle/anomalous accepted.

POST_motion_features_validation_batch_si.description: Rejects batches > 12 windows with 422 (per-call cost cap).

POST_motion_features_idempotency.description: Idempotent on (device_id, window_started_at). Second identical call returns status=duplicate, not inserted, no 500, no duplicate row.

POST_motion_features_response_shape.description: Response includes telemetry_pipeline_version field. Returns {status, inserted, duplicate, failed, results}.

POST_motion_features_happy_path.description: Single window with valid activity_class returns 200 with inserted=1, duplicate=0, failed=0.

POST_motion_features_partial_batch.description: Batch with multiple windows returns per-row results array.

trust_badge_motion_stale.description: Badge returns {level, color, reason}. Motion staleness surfaces as MEDIUM only, never LOW.

fall_detection_regression.description: 5-stage fall detection pipeline still works. GET /api/sensors/fall/events and POST /api/sensors/fall both respond.

risk_predict_regression.description: GET /api/risk/predict still works with model_version and pipeline_version in response.
